summary: Protected cycle paths linking the historic centre to residential districts and the university.
description: A phased build-out of kerb-separated cycleways and bike-parking hubs, replacing painted lanes with protected tracks to make everyday cycling viable year round.
funding_source: EU Cohesion Fund and city budget

summary: A citywide programme to roughly double cycling's modal share through new routes and secure parking.
description: Bern's Velo-Offensive expands the cycle network, adds velostations at rail hubs and re-times junctions for bikes, aiming to make cycling the default for short urban trips.

summary: A low-carbon district densifying around transit east of Paris, in the Marne-la-Vallée agglomeration.
description: Cité Descartes pairs energy-positive buildings with a district heat network and transit-oriented density, testing how a peri-urban hub can grow without car dependence.

summary: Public squares that double as stormwater buffers to prevent flooding during cloudbursts.
description: Den Bosch rebuilt several squares as water plazas that stay dry and usable most of the year but store cloudburst runoff, cutting flood risk as rainfall intensifies.
funding_source: Municipality and Waterschap Aa en Maas

summary: A network of green corridors connecting the city's parks for walking, cycling and cooling.
description: Lisbon's green corridors stitch fragmented parks into continuous walkable routes, adding tree canopy and permeable ground to cool streets and shelter biodiversity.

summary: A former logistics site in Espoo redeveloped as a low-emission, circular district on the rail line.
description: Kera turns a warehouse zone into a dense district generating more energy than it uses, with circular-construction targets and a new commuter-rail station cutting car trips.
funding_source: City of Espoo and private developers

summary: A cycling and walking greenway along the Baťa canal linking Zlín to surrounding towns.
description: The greenway connects Zlín with rural municipalities along the historic Baťa canal, spreading tourism and everyday mobility benefits beyond the city core.
funding_source: Zlín Region and EU rural funds

project_title: Anillo Verde – green belt and marsh buffer
summary: An integrated green belt buffering the Odiel marshes and guiding climate-resilient growth.
description: Huelva's green belt combines flood buffering for the Odiel marshes with an integrated land-use policy that steers development away from at-risk zones.
funding_source: Junta de Andalucía and EU funds

summary: Refurbishing public housing to keep residents living in the historic centre despite tourism pressure.
description: Venice is renovating vacant public housing and capping short-let conversions to keep working residents in the lagoon city as tourism drives up costs.
funding_source: Comune di Venezia and regional funds
